name: Bridging the Divide: Confronting Anti-Blackness in Asian American Community
address: South Asia Institute, 1925 South Michigan Avenue Chicago, IL 60616
description: In collaboration with the South Asian Solidarity Movement (SASM), this community workshop event will center issues of African American and Asian American caste systems and various race relations. Participants will engage in self-reflection and explore key concepts and allyship strategies to be catalysts of racial inclusion within their families and communities.
